title: After building you land on Lines, the finding is marked done, rebuild asks
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in with 'Work order lines - Create & Edit' and 'Work orders - Create & Edit', on the build under test; ShopCoach is enabled and the shop has at least one labor type.
  2. A completed inspection with at least one Monitor or Not OK finding, run on a work order. Seed it:
  3. ↳ Open a work order for a customer and asset (Work Orders > New, pick the customer/unit).
  4. ↳ Start an inspection from a template that has a checkbox field; mark one field Not OK and one Monitor.
  5. ↳ Complete and sign the inspection so it is in its read-only completed view.
  6. ↳ Have one inspection you will draft-then-abandon, and one you will fully add lines from twice.
custom_steps:
1. Choose a target and confirm you arrive on that work order's Lines tab immediately, watching drafting finish there.
2. Draft but abandon before adding; confirm the inspection still counts as needing a work order.
3. Add the lines; confirm the inspection no longer counts as needing a work order.
4. Press Add Lines a second time from the same inspection; confirm you are asked to confirm before a second set is added.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • The user lands on the target work order's Lines tab as soon as the target is chosen, before drafting finishes, and watches it complete there.
  • Once the lines are added, the inspection no longer counts as needing a work order; drafting alone does not change that.
  • If lines were already added from this inspection, the user is asked to confirm before adding a second set, checked when Add Lines is pressed.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-8181, story SV-9100 (S2 — Turn findings into work order lines); Digital Inspections V2 specification, Confluence page 768507905, section S2; read on 22 September 2026.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S2-R11: “The user will arrive on the target work order's Lines tab as soon as the target is chosen, before the drafting has finished, and will watch it complete there”
  • S2-R12: “Once the lines have been added, the inspection will no longer count as needing a work order. Drafting alone does not change that state, because a draft the user abandoned left the findings unactioned”
  • S2-R13: “If lines have already been added from this inspection, the user will be asked to confirm before adding a second set. The check is made when Add Lines is pressed, on the state at that moment”

Last checked against build v26.36.8-2a64085 on 10/1/2026.
